evals.prompt: I want to add an owner column to Datatest.md to indicate which service each variable comes from.
evals.expected_output: allowed — adding a column to Datatest.md is a format change within this skill scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill explains that Datatest.md is this skill own output and its format can be changed directly
skill does not refuse or redirect to another stage

evals.prompt: I want to change the status value from 'new → self-report' to just 'MISSING' to make it easier to read.
evals.expected_output: allowed — changing status convention in Datatest.md is within scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill states that the change can be made within this skill by updating the status value from new → self-report to MISSING
skill does not redirect to self-report or another stage

evals.prompt: I want self-report to be triggered immediately each time a gap is found instead of aggregating once at the end.
evals.expected_output: allowed — changing the trigger timing in step 5 is within scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill explains that the trigger timing can be changed by moving the self-report call from step 5 to between steps 2-4, firing once per gap instead of aggregating at the end
skill does not redirect to the self-report skill

evals.prompt: I want to add a check that every row in Datatest.md has a value before PAUSEing.
evals.expected_output: allowed — adding a self-consistency check to step 7 is within scope

skill identifies step 7 (self-consistency check before PAUSE) as the right place
skill does not redirect to another stage
